title: Lashup high-powered over-the-horizon radar

tellings.quote: It was it was they were testing it for the Navy. It was called lashup. Lashup later became adopted by the air force as well.

plain: A researcher of UFO crash cases named Scott Ramsay, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, describes a powerful radar called Lashup that could see beyond the horizon. He says it was being tested for the Navy in New Mexico in the late 1940s and 1950s, and that the Air Force later took it up too. He tells it because such a radar could have tracked the strange objects reported over New Mexico in those years.
